Package com.composum.sling.platform.staging.impl

Class NodeTreeSynchronizer

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.composum.sling.platform.staging.impl.NodeTreeSynchronizer
  • public class NodeTreeSynchronizer
extends Object
    Helper to copy / update a resource tree into another resource tree while some attributes are omitted and some nodes can be transformed.

      • update

        public void update​(@NotNull
                   @NotNull org.apache.sling.api.resource.Resource from,
                   @NotNull
                   @NotNull org.apache.sling.api.resource.Resource to)
            throws javax.jcr.RepositoryException,
                   org.apache.sling.api.resource.PersistenceException
        Updates the resource tree below {to} to match the resource tree below {from}, creating missing nodes, removing superfluous nodes, setting / removing attributes. Protected attributes are ignored (e.g. jcr:uuid can't be set) - see ignoreAttribute(ResourceHandle, String, boolean).
        Parameters:
        from - the source
        to - the destination which we update
        Throws:
        javax.jcr.RepositoryException - if we couldn't finish the operation
        org.apache.sling.api.resource.PersistenceException
        See Also:
        ignoreAttribute(ResourceHandle, String, boolean)

Protected attributes are ignored (e.g. jcr:uuid can't be set) - see ignoreAttribute(ResourceHandle, String, boolean).
        Parameters:

      • updateAttributes

        public boolean updateAttributes​(@NotNull
                                @NotNull com.composum.sling.core.ResourceHandle from,
                                @NotNull
                                @NotNull com.composum.sling.core.ResourceHandle to,
                                @NotNull
                                @NotNull com.google.common.collect.BiMap<String,​String> attributeNameTranslation)
                         throws javax.jcr.RepositoryException
        Updates all attributes of {to} from their values at {from} - including primary type and mixins. Protected attributes are ignored (e.g. jcr:uuid can't be set) - see ignoreAttribute(ResourceHandle, String, boolean). We implement this using JCR directly, since Map.put(Object, Object) breaks on references.
        Parameters:
        from - the source
        to - the destination which we update
        attributeNameTranslation - any attribute contained in this map will be written to the attribute according to the value in the destination. The primary type or mixin types of the destination will only be touched if it's not translated or translated from a (different) attribute.
        Returns:
        true when there were any differences in the attributes
        Throws:
        javax.jcr.RepositoryException - if we couldn't finish the operation
        See Also:
        ignoreAttribute(ResourceHandle, String, boolean)

      • ignoreAttribute

        protected boolean ignoreAttribute​(com.composum.sling.core.ResourceHandle resource,
                                  String attributename,
                                  boolean source)
        Specifies if the attribute is ignored in the synchronization process. In the default implementation we exclude some protected attributes from the source.
        Parameters:
        resource - the resource that has the attribute
        attributename - the name of the attribute
        source - true if that's the source, false if that's the destination
        Returns:
        true iff the attribute should be copied.
